clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore, giant sea turtles lie dead on the coast and beneath the waves. Their remains go to researchers in Auberdine, who study the growing number of strandings.

Giant sea creatures are washing ashore along Darkshore, while others lie beneath the water near sunken wrecks. In Auberdine, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde oversees the collection of bone fragments and tissue from the bodies. The Temple of the Moon in Darnassus urgently requests these samples. Its scholars and priestesses fear the creatures may be fleeing an unnatural disturbance in the waters around Teldrassil.

Recovering the remains is dangerous. Murloc tribes along the coast routinely gather around the huge carcasses, picking bones clean and nesting beside them. Scholars need fresh bone fragments and tissue before the scavengers destroy evidence that could explain the creatures' fatal migration.
